title: 宿敵現る！ワガママ王女との場外乱闘

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm at a cafe that's been rented out to film a TV special! And my discussion partner is Sweep! Wha—?! Why's she picking a fight?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup and show everyone that I'm a princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Trainer's being all sneaky and hides some kind of bag from me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No way! Could it be a present for when I win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup?! Ohhh! Time for a Princess☆Bomber!
